scorecard.name: Hold time and Dead Air
scorecard.coaching: Dead Air Breach: Agent had 2 occurrences of >30s unmanaged dead air.

scorecard.name: Verified customer
scorecard.coaching: Agent failed to ask for a PIN, address, or security question within the first 4 minutes of the call.

scorecard.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
scorecard.coaching: Agent failed to address customer by name 'Sonia' during the call.

scorecard.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
scorecard.coaching: Failed to acknowledge customer's severe distress and panic at turn 21 regarding 999 dispatch work.

scorecard.name: Paraphrasing
scorecard.coaching: Failed to paraphrase customer's direct debit issue at the beginning of the call.

scorecard.name: Active listening
scorecard.coaching: Asked customer at turn 41 for postal address which was already provided at turn 3.

scorecard.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
scorecard.coaching: Insulted customer at turn 11: 'If you cannot manage your bank account standing orders responsibly, you should pay by cash at a Post Office counter.'

scorecard.name: Probing
scorecard.coaching: Failed to probe effectively regarding bank merger details or direct debit return specifics.

scorecard.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
scorecard.coaching: Failed to confirm that automated disconnection had been cancelled in the provisioning system.

grader.scenario: Direct debit cancelled by bank clerical error causing urgent disconnection warning; 2 outbursts (one handled, one unhandled); 6+ faults (poor)
grader.notes: Poor call featuring multiple dead air breaches, two customer outbursts (first handled, second unhandled), rude remarks, failed verification and personalization, and active listening repeat.
